items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Eh… And the G.F. Deli, he had a beat-up piano on the first floor, and a little [first?] where a band for $10 an hour, or a few dollars an hour, you could go to rehearse. And I passed by there, and I hear some great stuff. I go upstairs, and it was Donald Byrd playing the trumpet, right. And Dunlop, a drummer.
